name: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd
title: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation Ltd - 500645 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 EBITDA fell to INR354 crores on fertiliser input-cost squeeze, IPA price pressure and a ~INR75 crore ammonia shutdown hit; management points to firming TAN/ammonia spreads, Equinor gas and Gopalpur commissioning in Q2 FY27.

capex.quote: both projects remain within the approved capex envelope

triggers.label: Ammonia spreads firming, up-cycle
triggers.quote: This point of time, we are in a, I'd say, up cycle and definitely right time for ammonia business to turn around and to make money.

triggers.label: Channel inventory elevated in fertiliser
triggers.quote: Currently, the inventory is slightly higher in the trade. Channel inventory is slightly higher.

triggers.label: Gopalpur TAN utilisation 90-95% by year-end
triggers.quote: we should be at least touching 90% to 95% utilization on a TPD basis

triggers.label: Gopalpur delayed again to Q2 FY27
triggers.quote: Commissioning is expected in Q2 FY '27, and both projects remain within the approved capex envelope.

guidance.metric: Gopalpur TAN and Dahej nitric acid commissioning
guidance.quote: Commissioning is expected in Q2 FY '27

guidance.metric: Gopalpur TAN utilisation on TPD basis
guidance.quote: we should be at least touching 90% to 95% utilization on a TPD basis

guidance.value: back to normal maintenance levels, INR800-1,000 crores remaining in FY27
guidance.quote: there is almost INR 800 crores to INR1,000 crores capex spending, including maintenance

red_flags.label: Working capital build in fertiliser
red_flags.quote: Our receivables and inventory days have gone up significantly during the year.

red_flags.label: Project delays from skilled labour shortage
red_flags.quote: it was more led by nonavailability of skilled workforce

evasions.quote: I will not go with the number.
Not yet, I won't give a debt number at this point of time
that's an information still not available for public or in the public domain.
